plan.title: Fix SvelteKit 'unknown prop params' Warning
plan.description: Comprehensive action plan to resolve console warnings "Page was created with unknown prop 'params'" appearing during navigation in SvelteKit 2 application.

issue_analysis.root_cause: SvelteKit 2 migration issue where page components receive 'params' prop they don't explicitly declare. This occurs when SvelteKit internally passes route parameters to page components that don't expect them.
issue_analysis.impact: Produces console warnings but doesn't break functionality

step.action: Search for page components potentially using params prop
step.expected_outcome: Identify components explicitly declaring or using params

step.action: Check for dynamic route segments
step.expected_outcome: Find directories with dynamic route parameters like [id] or [slug]

step.action: Examine load functions for parameter passing
step.expected_outcome: Review how parameters are passed from load functions to page components

step.action: Monitor runtime console for specific warning patterns
step.command: docker exec budget-frontend npm run dev
step.navigation_test: Navigate between pages to trigger warnings
step.expected_outcome: Capture exact warning messages and stack traces

step.action: Check SvelteKit generated types for parameter interfaces
step.command: docker exec budget-frontend npx svelte-kit sync
step.expected_outcome: Generate fresh type definitions and examine PageData interfaces

step.action: Audit all page components for prop declarations
Review page component prop interfaces
step.examine: - PageData type usage - Props interface declarations - Component script tag parameter handling

step.action: Check for undeclared prop usage patterns

search_patterns.pattern: Component receiving params without declaring them

phase_3.title: Implement Fixes
phase_3.approach: SvelteKit 2 best practices for parameter handling

step.action: Remove explicit params prop declarations from page components
step.rationale: In SvelteKit 2, params should be accessed via $page store or load functions

pattern_fix.after: // Remove this line - access params via $page.params

step.action: Update parameter access to use $page store
Ensure load functions handle parameters correctly
Update TypeScript interfaces for page components

interface_fix.ensure: Components don't expect params in props

Clear SvelteKit cache and rebuild types

key_changes.change: Parameters accessed via $page.params store, not component props
Load functions should not return params directly to components
Page components should not declare export let params
TypeScript interfaces should not include params in PageData

pattern_1.name: Dynamic Route Parameter Access
pattern_1.before: export let params; const id = params.id;

expected_outcomes.outcome: Improved compliance with SvelteKit 2 best practices
Better separation of concerns between routing and components
Enhanced development experience with no console noise
